query: Under which plausible allocation endogeneity scenarios do RD and shift-share IV fail, and which targeted falsification tests detect these failures?

response.query: Under which plausible allocation endogeneity scenarios do RD and shift-share IV fail, and which targeted falsification tests detect these failures?
response.answer: RD and shift-share IV fail under allocation endogeneity when treatment timing is non-random or influenced by local factors. Targeted falsification tests like placebo tests detect these failures.

results.title: SNTI) advances SENTI-202 gene circuit CAR-NK program
results.content: **Senti Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotech company developing gene circuit–enabled cell and gene therapies, with a primary focus on oncology.** Its lead program, SENTI-202, is an off-the-shelf CAR-NK cell therapy for relapsed/refractory hematologic malignancies, including acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Our lead product candidate, SENTI-202, is a potentially first-in-class Logic Gated off-the-shelf CAR-NK cell therapy for the treatment of blood cancers currently being studied in an open-label, multi-center Phase 1 clinical trial in the United States and Australia for the treatment of relapsed/refractory hematological malignancies, including Acute Myeloid Leukemia (“AML”). |  | Amended and Restated Development and Manufacturing Services Agreement between Senti Biosciences, Inc. and GeneFab, LLC dated December 10, 2024 | 10-K | 001-40440 | 10.43 | March 20, 2025 |.
